articles.title: CME Group to Launch 100-Ounce Silver Futures to Meet Record Retail Demand
articles.mainIdea: CME Group to Launch 100-Ounce Silver Futures to Meet Record Retail Demand
articles.summary: PR Newswire: CME Group to Launch 100-Ounce Silver Futures to Meet Record Retail Demand. CME Group, the world's leading derivatives marketplace, today announced it will launch a 100-Ounce Silver futures contract on February 9, 2026, pending regulatory review. Related tickers mentioned: CME, HOOD, SI=F.

articles.title: Ex-sailor sentenced to over 16 years for selling Navy secrets to China
articles.mainIdea: Ex-sailor sentenced to over 16 years for selling Navy secrets to China
articles.summary: USA TODAY: Ex-sailor sentenced to over 16 years for selling Navy secrets to China. Jinchao Wei sold thousands of documents and dozens of manuals about U.S. military ships, officials said.
